basis: PMID 32086342 / PMC7299809 (Clin Cancer Res 2020, doi 10.1158/1078-0432.CCR-19-2706), Results: 'We generated a tissue microarray (TMA) of 32 patient-matched NF/PNF and MPNST pairs that included 3 ANNUBPs from 12 NF1 patients cared for at the Iowa NF Clinic'; Methods: '12 paired neurofibromas and MPNSTs ..., 1 unpaired neurofibroma and 2 unpaired MPNSTs' from University of Iowa Pathology under IRB 201507708; the RNA-seq used FFPE cores adjacent to those TMA cores.
caveat: Cohort-level statement only: clinical NF1 diagnosis at an NF clinic, not per-patient germline sequencing ('germline' does not appear in the paper). The paper ties '12 NF1 patients' to the paired TMA cohort while GEO carries 15 distinct patient ids; the retrieved text does not reconcile the two, so confidence stays medium and the patient mapping is still open.

basis: PMID 34040258 Extended Data Table 1: the RNA-seq non-neoplastic brain group is NOP454N plus DIPG46N/DIPG51N/DIPG48N/DIPG70N, the latter four being frontal cortex from DIPG patients; NOP454N pairs by id with NF1-PA sample NOP454. Methods: samples came from paediatric tumour banks at St. Louis Children's Hospital, UCLA and Stanford.
caveat: Needs a sixth value in the control taxonomy: 'control_nonneoplastic_other_disease' for non-neoplastic tissue from patients with an unrelated tumour. Paediatric 'normal brain' in GEO is nearly always of this kind, so the gap will recur beyond this dataset.
